'''Bubahl's Grasp''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped by [[Bubahl Icehands]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Marga Coast]].

==Stats==
:[[Earth damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]]) 
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%) 
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +7 (vs. [[physical damage]])
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ancient Scythe (common)]] dyed silver.

==Replica==

*One of the following [[Scythe]]s:
**[[Briarwood Scythe]] from collectors [[Fopp]] or [[Pathfinder Mia]] 
**[[Elegant Scythe]] from collectors [[Pathfinder Alon]] or [[Blonk]]
**[[Hooked Scythe]] from collectors [[Klakki the Squire]] or [[Kaplack]]
**[[Suntouched Scythe]] from collectors [[Chinwe]] or [[Roland le Moisson]] or crafters [[Hahbe]], [[Kol Swordshanks]], [[Asiri]] or [[Aksah]]
**[[Destroyer Scythe]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Scythe]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Scythe]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Ebon]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Scythe Grip]] [[of Shelter]]
OR
*One of the following [[Scythe]]s:

==Trivia== 
Though the boss that drops this scythe is named Bubahl Icehands, whose attacks require cold damage dealing weapons, the scythe deals earth damage rather than cold damage.
